items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Jess Stacey was the big band player with Goodman... I only played with the trio and and quartet.

ctx.x: And in regard to the piano, I did the whole piano sound track, but the truth of the matter, Jess Stacey should have been on the big banders, the big band tracks, because in real life, I only played with the trio and and quartet. Jess Stacey was the big band player with Goodman.

He was with the band when I joined it in the Congress Hotel in Chicago -- I joined to play only with the trio, and then later, of course the quartet with Lionel -- and even after I left, Stacey was still the big band player with Goodman.
